insights.one_liner: TRUMPF Nederland is the Dutch arm of a family-owned maker of machine tools, lasers and industrial electronics; a visa sponsor with an entry engineering role in Veldhoven.

culture.text: A Dutch team of about 150 people, mostly engineers in mechatronics, mechanical and electrical engineering, often from Saxion and HAN.
It describes itself as an independent family business that thinks and acts long-term.
